author: Xenokal
quote:
This is the game industry's return to form. This is why we gamers play games. A game that was already perfect now ascending to a realm of absolute peak. Just when I started to lose faith in Nintendo with the epic failure of Pokemon Legends and Scarlet and Violet. They turn around and allow me to behold this masterpiece. 

Gone are the pressures of microtransactions. The game is 100% Complete upon loading it. No need for some massive day one patch. Just pop the card in and you're off. It encapsulated everything that gave the original Ocarina of Time a 99/100 and expanded  on it. The graphics are crisp yet not too hyper realistic. The memorable characters are completely fleshed out and visually stunning. The game's new art direction breathes a whole  new air of life into the game, making it visually breathtaking. 

As someone who has replayed the original OoT countless times over, I found this game almost identical yet it does have its differences but all of which was in a good way (except for some needless dialog changes). I enjoyed every minute of the game and I can see myself replaying it more times in the future,

This should be a massive wake up call for the western game industry.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Xenokal
quote:
Game is a buggy, glitchy mess. The freedoms afforded to you in GTA4 and GTA5 have been morally policed. Low 30FPS caps in 2026 is unforgivable. FPS drops in combat. 4-5hrs of Relationship Simulating. Uninteresting Male protagonist, total "girl boss" bullcrap. Game feels like it was developed by interns. Graphics while being really good, is pointless if your overall game is hot garbage. 100 dollar price tag to unlock content in a single player game? 

I was a huge GTA fan, but this feels like a punch to the stomach. 13years of waiting, delay after delay after delay, all the talk about it needing time to polish, only to be met by this hot garbage. GTAV is still better than this by lightyears.
Can't even get a refund, epic betrayal.
